auditor_value: (a) t = √(2×45/10) = 3 s; (b) QP = 40 × 3 = 120 m; (c) v = √(40² + 30²) = 50 m/s at tan⁻¹(30/40) ≈ 37° below the horizontal

findings.quote: Restating every part: the time of flight is 3 s, the distance QP is 120 m, and the velocity at P is 50 m/s at 37° below the horizontal.
findings.note: Duplicated prose: the same three results are printed again in this step's equation and a third time in final_answer. The step text should describe only what the equation does.
findings.fix: Combine the components to get the speed and direction at P: the magnitude is the hypotenuse of the 40 m/s and 30 m/s components, and the direction is the angle whose tangent is 30/40.

question_defect: The served question text lists the three parts twice (once in the opening sentence and again as (a)/(b)/(c) lines). The launch speed 40 m/s and tower height 45 m appear only in the figure description, not in the question text.
notes: Physics checked: 45 = 5t² → t = 3 s; QP = 120 m; v_y = 30 m/s; √(1600 + 900) = 50 m/s; tan⁻¹(0.75) = 36.87° ≈ 37°. The mistake entry (40 + 30 = 70) is a genuine scalar-addition error.
